additional_info.subject: ID0474777-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2/T10 4002922671] Error Code Message Displayed CRM:03289000375
additional_info.body:
Dear Pedro António,
Thank you for your patience as we investigated the issues you reported concerning the "vendorErrorCode":"secc pilot is E" and "vendorErrorCode":"router1 connection loss." We're pleased to confirm that these issues have now cleared.
Our review confirmed the following:
"vendorErrorCode":"secc pilot is E"
: This was caused by an intermittent Ethernet connection drop during a pre-charge session. The connection automatically re-established, and the issue resolved itself quickly.
"vendorErrorCode":"router1 connection loss"
: This error was a temporary result of a recent charging station reboot, which took a little longer than usual to complete.
These log entries illustrate the temporary nature of these alerts.
Please do not hesitate to contact us if you require any further information.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team

Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Regarding the issue you reported this morning, we've completed our check and can confirm that both charging outlets are currently available and actively engaged in charging sessions. We've attached a picture for your reference, showing the current operational status.

Best regards,
Ivan
